{{Top|leg}}
The '''ThinHut''' was a small, three [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meter]] shelter that gave a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] protection against cold and [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. It had a thirty-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] exposure time for most [[Alien/Legends|alien]] environments, and was constructed of material that was a slightly thicker version of that which was used in the [[Thinsuit/Legends|Thinsuit]]. It was resistant to tear, slashing, and puncturing, and could be folded into a size no larger than a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].
